_read_me: 2026-27 PG fees verified 4 Nov 2026 in each authority's / college's own 2026-27 document. Show 'tuition_inr' as 'Tuition fee' where show_as is 'Tuition fee'; where show_as starts with 'Fee (as printed)', show 'amount' with that wording and never call it tuition. 'period' says per year / whole course / not stated - never divide a whole-course figure into years, never invent a period. Dollar amounts are the college's own figure; a rupee view of them is at the FBIL rate Rs 95.9832/$ (30.09.2026) and must say approx.
